target.statement: Random Forest 5-fold stratified cross-validation accuracy of 97.5% ± 1.6% for predicting placement category from 40 binary item responses (n=198)
target.dataset: 40-item mathematics placement exam, 198 students, 7 terms (Summer 2022–Fall 2024), ECSU institutional data

compute.basis: The analysis is tiny (198x40 binary matrix, RF/GB/SVM/MLP with 5-fold CV) and would run in seconds on CPU; the only real cost is writing the pipeline, but the raw student response data is not public.

blockers: Raw item-level student response data (198x40 binary matrix) is institutional data from ECSU, not released
No code or data links in the paper
Exact CV fold seeds and preprocessing not specified, so exact 97.5% ± 1.6% cannot be matched even with data
title: Multi-Method Analysis of Mathematics Placement Assessments: Classical, Machine Learning, and Clustering Approaches
